title: Verify accepted-receipt replay keeps the action key
description: Evidence: review docs/reviews/2026-10-07-e1-guard-refusals-review.md finding E1-D5 (PR #288, batch loka-e1-r9-certification-2rz.9). kernel/ts/src/runtime/world.ts:119-120 says no two actions match one Command, but the E1 Wick and Aldric cases show an unlabelled talk Command can admit a different dialogue when decided without the action key. Production decides with the key (mobile/authority/local-story/invocation.ts:173); refused receipts are never re-decided (invocation.ts:50, receipt-history.ts:28). Open question: does reopening a save re-decide ACCEPTED receipts without the action key? If so, an accepted talk could replay as a different dialogue (save-integrity defect). Investigate first; then fix (store the key in the host trace) or correct the comment, with a red control.
notes: No replay defect: reopen re-decides accepted receipts only; key narrows admission, rule/mint never see it. Comment corrected at world.ts:119 (e1/coq-replay-key e4ec9744), integrated into #288 at b199b05b. Red control: infirmary.test.ts:60. Residual (ponytail): query_steps near limit fails closed. Closes when #288 merges.

Removing any of these checks leaves the local-story suite green, so a forged save reopens instead of save_corrupt: (1) mobile/authority/local-story/deadline-save.ts:186 accept receipt quest.activate instance/bindings; (2) deadline-save.ts:191 job.schedule count and job id, and the availability-window within(...) check; (3) deadline-receipts.ts:215 quest-outcome fact_changed event (twin of M5); (4) deadline-receipts.ts expires(): expiry receipt trust value, trust-write writer group, outcome value. Fix: one real-SQLite forge+reopen test per check expecting save_corrupt, each with its mutant as red control; first run the full local-story suite against each mutant to drop any already caught.
